source.name: Mapzen / AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium)
source.attribution: Mapzen / AWS Terrain Tiles; global GMTED2010 and SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; global ETOPO1 terrain data: NOAA.
source.projection: Source: Web Mercator EPSG:3857; output: regular longitude/latitude WGS84 grid
source.processing: Bilinear sampling of z6 Terrarium pixel-center elevations; rounded to the nearest meter. No synthetic noise or invented mountains.
source.limitations: Modern generalized DEM, not an ancient terrain/shoreline reconstruction. Ocean bathymetry retained as negative values. Values <=0 may also include inland depressions. Vertical exaggeration in the viewer is a visual aid, not measured proportions. Not for navigation, surveying, precise battlefield topography, or flood analysis.
